description: This source file defines a UIAnimation class that handles animated transitions for icon interactions in an Android wearable app, including zooming in/out of icons and managing UI state changes.

classes.name: UIAnimation
classes.description: A helper class providing animated zoom effects for icons in the app's UI, managing icon states and user interactions.

classes.name: UIAnimation.UIState
classes.description: An enumeration representing the UI's current state, such as MIC_UP, SOUND_UP, MUSIC_UP, or HOME.

classes.name: UIAnimation.UIStateListener
classes.description: An interface for callback when UI state changes occur.

methods.name: UIAnimation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UIAnimation with views, animation duration, and a listener.

methods.name: zoomImageFromThumb
methods.description: Handles the zoom-in and zoom-out animation for a selected icon thumbnail.

methods.name: transitionToHome
methods.description: Programmatically transitions the UI back to the home state by simulating a click on the expanded image.
